description:
## Why

RFC 5257 IMAP ANNOTATION allows per-message server-side metadata
stored separately from the message itself and exposed to IMAP clients.
This is the right place to surface stoa's authentication evidence
(DKIM result, SPF result, DMARC policy, spam score) to mail clients
without injecting headers into the immutable message body.

## Dependency

Requires a working IMAP server in stoa-reader. stoa v1 does not have
one. This epic is deferred until IMAP is implemented. Filed now to
capture the design intent.

## What (when IMAP exists)

Expose per-message annotations keyed by CID:

| Annotation entry                         | Value |
|------------------------------------------|-------|
| /vendor/stoa/dkim-result                 | pass / fail / none |
| /vendor/stoa/dkim-domain                 | signing domain or empty |
| /vendor/stoa/spf-result                  | pass / fail / softfail / none |
| /vendor/stoa/dmarc-result                | pass / fail / none |
| /vendor/stoa/dmarc-policy                | reject / quarantine / none |
| /vendor/stoa/spam-score                  | float as string e.g. '2.3' |
| /vendor/stoa/cid                         | CIDv1 of the article |

Source: dns_auth_cache table + article_verifications table, looked
up by CID at FETCH time. No header injection; the message bytes are
unchanged.

## IMAP capability advertisement

ANNOTATE-EXPERIMENT-1 (RFC 5257 experimental) or ANNOTATION (if
standardized) advertised in CAPABILITY response.

## Client usage

Thunderbird, Apple Mail, and other RFC 5257 clients can display
annotations. A custom Thunderbird extension could render DKIM/SPF
results in the message header pane sourced from annotations rather
than parsing Authentication-Results: headers.

## Acceptance (when IMAP is implemented)

- CAPABILITY response includes ANNOTATE-EXPERIMENT-1
- FETCH ANNOTATION returns correct values for all /vendor/stoa/* entries
- Values sourced from dns_auth_cache; not re-computed at FETCH time
- Unknown annotations return NIL per RFC 5257 §4.3
title: IMAP ANNOTATION (RFC 5257) for per-message auth metadata
